title: Pk Table Schema
description: Validates pk-table.json and files exported by the Pk matrix builder: a dense defense system × attack platform matrix of per-shot kill probability and shots per engagement.

name.description: Display name shown in the tool's header badge.

tiers.description: Multipliers applied to a cell's pk after a random tier roll (u ≥ 0.67 high, u ≥ 0.33 medium, else low). All three at 1.0 make Pk deterministic and skip the roll.

cells.description: Keyed by defense system id (defenses.json), then by attack platform id (attacks.json).

pk.description: Per-shot probability of kill. 0 means the system cannot engage this platform.

shots.description: Interceptors fired per threat engaged (kinetic, patrol), rounds per burst (gun), or 0 (directed energy).
